metric_name: Flash Response Index (FRI) / ON–OFF contrast preference
biological_quantity: Preference for luminance increments versus decrements from flash responses
experimentally_established_target: ON/OFF preference for 32 characterized cell types
cell_types_involved: 32 characterized types; paper also reports predictions for uncharacterized types
source_path_api_paper_figure: Nature 2024 Fig. 2b, Extended Data Fig. 6; local results_pretrained_models.zip contains validation_loss.h5 only
number_of_models_available: 0 reusable row-level FRI records in this repository (published figures show selected models/ensemble summaries)
suitability_for_A2: High after official-50 FRI values and the characterized target set are recovered
caveats: Use the published FRI definition and only experimentally characterized targets; do not substitute task loss.

metric_name: T4/T5 direction selectivity (DSI) and motion tuning
biological_quantity: Direction-selective response to moving ON/OFF edges; T4 ON-motion and T5 OFF-motion properties
experimentally_established_target: T4/T5 direction-selective tuning and known ON/OFF motion polarity
source_path_api_paper_figure: Nature 2024 Fig. 2c–d; local saved archives contain no moving-edge response table
number_of_models_available: 0 reusable official-50 model-level records in this repository (paper plots selected model/ensemble results)
suitability_for_A2: High if the full official-50 curves or a prespecified DSI agreement are generated
caveats: Preserve subtype and direction; confirm the published stimulus and DSI definitions before inference.

biological_quantity: Angular match between predicted and experimentally established preferred direction
experimentally_established_target: Cardinal preferred directions of T4/T5 subtypes
source_path_api_paper_figure: Nature 2024 Fig. 2c–d; no official-50 direction table bundled
number_of_models_available: 0 reusable official-50 rows in this repository
suitability_for_A2: Potentially suitable as a categorical or angular component, after the target and tie rule are fixed
caveats: Do not count this as an independent component if derived from the same moving-edge curves as DSI without an explicit dependence plan.

metric_name: Direction tuning of T4/T5 input cells
biological_quantity: Lack of direction tuning reported for nine input cell types
experimentally_established_target: Non-direction-selective responses under the tested conditions
cell_types_involved: Mi1, Tm3, Mi4, Mi9, Tm1, Tm2, Tm4, Tm9, CT1
source_path_api_paper_figure: Nature 2024 Results/Fig. 2; no official-50 model-level DSI table bundled
number_of_models_available: 0 reusable official-50 rows in this repository
suitability_for_A2: Useful only with a prespecified per-model tuning threshold and full input-cell coverage
caveats: Published ensemble-level agreement is not a per-model agreement score.

biological_quantity: Three-category T4c response phenotype and match to experimentally known preferred direction
suitability_for_A2: Valid single categorical component; insufficient alone for broader agreement or a composite score
caveats: Retain all three phenotypes; binary match is true only for cluster 0. Labels derive from saved naturalistic-response clusters, not a new moving-edge assay.

metric_name: Saved naturalistic-response cluster memberships across cell types
biological_quantity: Between-model grouping of predicted cell activity on naturalistic inputs
experimentally_established_target: No uniform experimental target for the 65 bundled cell-type cluster files
number_of_models_available: 50-model archive is the source; valid-label counts were not audited per cell type (T4c alone is verified N=50 in A1)
suitability_for_A2: Not a biological-response agreement metric as-is; retain as exploratory descriptive data only
caveats: Cluster labels are categorical model-response groupings, not measured response values or calibrated agreement scores. Only T4c has the independent phenotype mapping already validated in A1.

biological_quantity: Correlation or normalized error between model and experimental response curves
experimentally_established_target: Cell-type-specific tuning curves from cited electrophysiology studies
cell_types_involved: Selected T4/T5 and input cell types, depending on source experiment
source_path_api_paper_figure: Nature 2024 Fig. 2d and Supplementary Data 5–7; no aligned official-50 raw curves bundled
number_of_models_available: 0 reusable official-50 curve pairs in this repository
suitability_for_A2: High only after exact experimental traces, normalization, and model-level outputs are available
caveats: Paper-level correlations across selected models/model variants cannot be reassigned to all 50 official models.

biological_quantity: Optic-flow task performance, not a measured neural response
suitability_for_A2: Exclude from biological-response agreement; it is a task score
caveats: Including task loss would change the scientific question and would not create neural-response evidence.
